description: This Python module provides functions for adding context-specific attributes to OpenTelemetry spans related to various AI and speech services, including TTS, STT, LLM, Gemini Live, and OpenAI Realtime. It includes utility functions for extracting service information and annotating spans with rich metadata for observability.
